policy: A quarantined row stays absent until club, goals, assists, appearances and market value each have two independent sources. A transfer season may need multiple club rows.

batchEvidence.classification: generated projection tranche, not verified completed-season data
batchEvidence.decision: Quarantine the full seed-derived tranche. This does not claim every tuple is individually false. It records that none of the batch can be treated as completed-season fact without new verification.
evidence: Git history shows the 77 final fallback tuples were first authored from 2026-02-09 through 2026-04-10. Every authoring batch predates completion of the 2025-2026 season.

The 2026-05-25 seed migration names src/data/careerPlayers.ts as its source and materializes the same 77 player names. Seventy-three tuples match exactly and four use alternate values from duplicate resolution.
The seed-derived live rows share the database creation timestamp 2026-05-26 05:33:00.489436+00. The 27 preserved rows were inserted separately from 2026-07-08 through 2026-07-10.

Ten distinct seed or fallback tuples have independent source evidence disproving their club assignment. Those examples confirm the batch is unsafe, while the quarantine remains explicitly provenance-based.
